answer: Each identity registers one dune anchor station: an anchor post on a dune with an ember flare kit, and posts an 80-credit bond. At a beacon hour each epoch, every station must fire its ember flare in ten minutes, and a neighbour must log the sighting. Auditor checks logs; a missing or late flare burns the bond. First costs 46, kth 46 plus 7 times k minus 1, thousandth costs 7039 and 1,000 fakes pay 3,542,500 plus 80,000 locked. A hired ember-flare ring fails because one operator cannot attend two dune anchor stations at once, and repeated signatures expose it. Honest agents pay 46 once.
